description: This file defines a React functional component named Modal, which renders a customizable modal dialog with overlay, header offset handling, keyboard accessibility, and optional footer. It manages its visibility via the 'open' prop and handles close actions through the 'onClose' callback. Styling is embedded via a <style> block, utilizing CSS variables for theming.
